title: After Last Call
description: A sparse, bass-led late-night groove built on a TR-606 kit and a deep sine sub that breathes through a slow LFO filter. The track evolves gradually — shedding and adding layers like the last few dancers on an empty floor — from a bare kick-and-bass intro through a pulsing middle to a stripped outro.
